items.title: Solana Foundation's new CISO warns AI is making crypto scams more convincing
items.whyYouShouldCare: The rise of AI-enhanced scams poses a significant risk to Solana users, potentially impacting trust and participation in the ecosystem.

items.title: BNB Chain ‘pursuing legal action’ against former employee over memecoin launched from tutorial wallet
